models_evaluated: open-source LLMs 4B-70B parameters (4-bit and 8-bit quantized variants)

links.outcome: Consistency of LLM answers across semantically equivalent question variants
links.effect: Llama-3.1-70B had 97.3% consistency, but equivalent questions occasionally gave discordant responses; one correct and one clinically significant error in 0.96% of cases.
links.quote: semantically equivalent questions occasionally yielded discordant responses, including instances where one formulation was correct and the other contained a clinically significant error (0.96% of cases).

links.outcome: Rate of clinically significant errors in LLM outputs retrieving patient information from EHRs
links.effect: Clinical evaluation identified clinically significant errors in 2.9% of outputs; Llama-3.1-70B free-text accuracy was 95.3%.
links.quote: Clinical evaluation identified clinically significant errors in 2.9% of outputs

unlisted_practices: Locally hosted open-source LLM deployment without external data transfer
Low-precision quantization (4-bit and 8-bit) to reduce GPU memory requirements while preserving performance

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy, consistency, and clinical error rate of locally deployable open-source LLMs on clinical QA from Finnish EHRs using retrospective records and expert annotations, but does not compare a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
